build_effect_chain_audio: build an EffectChain to apply sox audio effects like pitch, rate, and dither to a torch tensor
create_time_dropout_augmentation: create a time dropout augmentation that zeros out random frame segments of an audio tensor
apply_additive_noise_augmentation: apply additive noise augmentation to an audio tensor with a configurable signal-to-noise ratio
apply_clip_value_augmentation: apply clip value augmentation that clamps audio signal values by a configurable factor
instantiate_sox_effect: instantiate a SoxEffect with a name and optional callable arguments for dynamic parameter generation
